name: mnemo
description: Token-thrifty, human-like long-term memory for AI agents: gist encoding, power-law forgetting, cue-triggered recall and prospective memory, exposed as six MCP tools.

description_i18n.en: Token-thrifty, human-like long-term memory for AI agents: gist encoding, power-law forgetting, cue-triggered recall and prospective memory, exposed as six MCP tools.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 给 AI agent 的省 token 类人长期记忆：要点编码、幂律遗忘、情境触发召回与前瞻记忆，以六个 MCP 工具暴露。

store_dir.title: Memory store
store_dir.description: Directory for the Markdown memory store. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

user_principal.title: User principal
user_principal.description: Identity bound to preferences, e.g. user:alice. Required for a remembered preference to be allowed to change behaviour.

vector_mode.title: Semantic search
vector_mode.description: off | auto | on. auto enables embeddings only above 5000 records. Leave off unless you have measured a benefit.
